label: s1_sub_010_ecology_01
text: Hello, hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_02
text: Looks like you’ve caught...[VAR 0x0202(0001)] kind[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s of Pokémon\nthat can be found around the land of Kitakami![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_03
text:
I guess it’s still early days for your time
here in Kitakami, right?\c
Be sure to meet tons and tons and TONS of
Pokémon that you can’t find back home![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_04
text:
You know why you find different Pokémon in
different places around the world? Climate!\c
The humid summers here mean it’s home to
lots of Pokémon that like things nice and damp![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_05
text:
If you head high up on Oni Mountain, you’ll find
volcanic gas leaking out of the ground!\c
Sounds like a comfy place for Pokémon that are
drawn to that sort of thing, doesn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_05_02
text: Though you should make sure not to inhale too\nmuch of that gas yourself, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_06
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Wooow, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! You’ve
almost
completed
the
Kitakami
Pokédex!\c
Keep on checking those Pokémon habitats in your
Pokédex and trying out raids in crystal caverns...
and you’ll have it complete in no time![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_07
text: Wait, are you telling me...you’ve caught them all?![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_08
text: Wow! WOW! A complete Kitakami Pokédex!\nThis is great—no, YOU’RE great![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_09
text: Thanks to all your hard work, I don’t think there’s\nanything more to be done when it comes to\r\nsurveying the Pokémon that live here in Kitakami![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_10
text: I really wish I had something to give you to\ncommemorate all your effort...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_11
text: Oh! I know![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_25
text: I’ll give you this charm I got at Kitakami Hall! It’s\na limited-edition souvenir they only sell there![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_12
text: Oh, and can you show me your Rotom Phone for\na second?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_13
text: Thanks to the diploma feature Director Clavell\nhelped with, we can celebrate your achievement\r\nin style, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_14
text: See? You can get a special message from the\ncompany that certifies Pokédex completion![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_15
text: You may have completed this Pokédex, but that\ndoesn’t mean your school trip has to end![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_16
text: I hope you’ll keep meeting lots and lots of new\nPokémon friends around Kitakami![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_17
text: The weather sure is nice... What a fresh start to a\nnew day![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_18
text: Kitakami summers sure are hot and muggy, aren’t\nthey? My lab coat is soaked through with sweat![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_19
text:
Don’t you think the colors of the sunset seem
paler here in Kitakami than in Paldea?\c
Maybe the sunlight refracts differently? Whatever
the cause, it is very pretty![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_20
text:
I see you’re working hard late into the night.\c
But make sure to take a look up at the sky
once in a while! There isn’t much light coming
from town, so you can really see the stars.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_21
text: Looks like we’re in for a wet one! Pokémon that\nlove rain must be going wild right now![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_22
text:
The rain does nothing to cool down the
oppressive heat of the Kitakami summer!
What a climate they have here!\c
It seems to exert quite the influence on the
ecosystem as well.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_23
text: Evening showers, huh? Take care—your body\ntemperature will drop if you don’t dry off![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_24
text: Visibility is poor at night, and the ground is all\nslippery from the rain. I wouldn’t want one of my\r\ndear students to go wandering off in the dark![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_010_ecology_stop
text:
Keep striving toward that goal of registering
200 species in your Kitakami Pokédex!\c
If you manage to pull it off, open up your
Pokédex App and press the X Button to get it
certified. And then come show me, of course![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
